verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents sub-issues, subtasks, or blocking/dependency links in GitHub Projects. The cited material covers views, custom fields, iterations, workflows and API item management, which are adjacent features and do not show work being broken down or dependent tasks being linked. The planning axis clearly applies to a project-tracking tool, so the absence of evidence is 'none'.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can break work into subtasks and link dependent tasks so blocking order is clear
